A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the differentiation status of gastrointestinal (GI) cancers is associated with KRT20 and placenta specific-8 (PLAC) expression.
KRT20 and/or PLAC8 expression may be a potential prognostic factor for well-differentiated GI cancer, particularly for CRC.
PLAC8 and its downstream target KRT20 are involved in CRC differentiation, which is a novel finding that may be of use to the development of therapeutic strategies for CRC.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the expression of KRT20 may be associated with differentiation status, particularly in CRC.
the differentiation status of gastrointestinal cancer may influence the expression of keratins and placenta specific protein 8.
the differentiation status of cancer cells may influence KRT20 expression and may explain why patients diagnosed with well-differentiation colorectal cancer have a better clinical outcome.
